component.name: Battery Monitor
component.summary: Battery health, telemetry, and power-usage dashboard

description.p: Battery Monitor is a native battery health and power dashboard for Linux laptops: live voltage/current/power/temperature telemetry, real health and degradation tracking, charging diagnostics, per-process power usage, and long-term history, all backed by real hardware data with nothing simulated.

ul.li: Live charge status with rolling voltage/current/power/temperature sparklines
Real health percentage, cycle count, and a 12-month degradation trend
Estimated system draw, CPU package power (Intel RAPL), and power profile status
Live USB-C Power Delivery negotiation details
Charge threshold read/write on supported hardware
Per-process CPU ranking and an optional PowerTop power-impact scan
Edge-triggered alerts for low/critical battery, temperature, and power spikes
CSV history export with configurable retention
System tray icon with a live wattage/percentage label

description.p: Everything runs locally against a SQLite database on your own machine — no telemetry, no accounts, no cloud dependency.
